tasks.page.stopBody: The running step stops now. Files it already changed stay as they are; git and rewind still work.
tasks.page.discardBody: Deletes its request, contract and triage from this workspace.
tasks.page.readingToDraft: Claude is reading the project to draft the contract (read-only).
tasks.page.readingToSplit: Claude is reading the project to split the task into sub-tasks.
tasks.page.splitReadOnly: Read-only: it can't change files. Each sub-task gets its own contract and tier.
tasks.page.messageStep: Message {{step}}: it joins the step's work, e.g. “keep the public API as it is”
tasks.page.stepTakesNoMessages: A step that runs Claude takes messages; this one runs the project's checks.
tasks.page.messageStepHint: Enter sends it to the running step
tasks.page.scheduleHint: Run this task again on a schedule, while AgentChainer is open
tasks.page.acceptUnverified: No gate ran, so nothing proved the task.
tasks.page.acceptFailed: The latest gate runs didn't all pass, so the task isn't proved.
tasks.page.acceptBody: The task ends as Accepted with risk, not Done. Your reason goes into the evidence report. Nothing in the working tree changes.
tasks.page.acceptReasonPlaceholder: e.g. The failing test is a known bug, tracked separately.
tasks.contract.title: Contract
tasks.contractCard.hint: Reply below to change it, or edit it here.
tasks.facts.title: Task
tasks.composer.replyHint: Enter redrafts the contract with your reply
tasks.composer.replyPlaceholder: Reply to change the contract, e.g. “leave applyDiscount alone” or “add a test for an empty cart”
tasks.contractForm.subtitle: Drafted by Claude. Edit anything before you approve.
tasks.contractForm.settleQuestions: Settle them by editing the contract, then remove them.
tasks.contractForm.objectiveHelp: The outcome in a sentence or two, not the steps.
tasks.contractForm.criteriaHelp: What counts as done, and how each is proved: a gate run, the reviewer, or you. Only gates with a detected command can prove anything.
tasks.contractForm.noCriteria: No criteria yet: a task needs at least one.
tasks.contractForm.affectedAreasHelp: Paths or globs Claude expects to change.
tasks.contractForm.outOfScopeHelp: Related work this task won't do.
tasks.contractForm.risksHelp: What could go wrong. Feeds triage and the report.
tasks.triage.title: Triage
tasks.triage.stale: The contract changed since this triage. Run triage again to update the proposal.
tasks.triage.unavailable: Unavailable: {{error}}. The proposal is the floor.
tasks.triage.floorAbove: The signals set a floor of {{floor}}, above Claude's {{tier}}.
tasks.triage.noBudgetHelp: No spend cap: the task runs until it's done or you stop it. Read-only steps keep their own small limits.
tasks.triage.budgetHelp: The task stops when it's spent.
tasks.contractView.runsFromXl: It runs from its XL task: approve the sub-tasks there, then run that task.
tasks.contractView.readyXl: Split it into sub-tasks from the footer: each gets its own contract, tier and git worktree, and you approve them before anything runs.
tasks.contractView.readyRun: Run it from the footer: each step is a Claude session you can watch here, and the app runs the gates itself.
tasks.run.title: Run
tasks.cost.estimateHint: Estimated from {{tokens}} tokens at the model's API price
tasks.cost.unknownHint: {{tokens}} tokens. This model has no known price, so it counts $0 toward the budget.
tasks.cost.unknownNoTokens: This model has no known price, so it counts $0 toward the budget.
tasks.run.parallelHint: Runs at the same time as the other {{group}} steps
tasks.run.subtaskNote: Runs its own tier's workflow in its worktree.
tasks.run.waiting: Waiting for the session's first words…
tasks.run.gatesSubtitle: Run by AgentChainer, with the real exit codes.
tasks.run.notRun: Not run, no command detected: {{gates}}. They don't count as passed.
tasks.evidence.title: Evidence
tasks.evidence.subtitle: From the run's records; Claude's own statements are labeled as such.
tasks.runButton.profile: Permission profile for the run's write steps
tasks.subtasks.title: Sub-tasks
tasks.subtasks.subtitle: In dependency order, two at once, each in its own worktree.
tasks.subtasks.openToEdit: Open a sub-task to edit its contract and tier, or approve them all as drafted.
tasks.subtasks.allApproved: Every sub-task is approved: run the task from the footer.
tasks.subtasks.branchStarts: The task branch starts from your last commit.
tasks.subtasks.branchStartsDirty: The task branch starts from your last commit; your uncommitted changes aren't part of it.
tasks.overlaps.alsoChanges: <task>{{title}}</task> also changes {{files}}. Merging both may conflict.
tasks.result.mergeNotFinished: Merge once the run is Done, or accept its risk first.
tasks.result.mergeDirty: Commit or stash your changes first.
tasks.result.removeBody: The task's folders in {{path}} are removed, with whatever was installed in them. What the run left uncommitted is committed on its branch first, and the branches stay, so no work is lost; delete them with git when you no longer need them.
tasks.result.title: Result
tasks.result.subtitle: On its own branch: your branch changes only when you merge it.
tasks.result.conflicts: The merge stopped on conflicts in {{files}}. Resolve and commit them, or abort the merge, in the Git panel.
tasks.approval.label: Approval
tasks.createPr.ghMissing: The GitHub CLI (gh) isn't installed. Install it, then sign in from a terminal with `gh auth login`.
tasks.createPr.ghSignedOut: gh isn't signed in to {{host}}. Run `gh auth login --hostname {{host}}` in a terminal.
tasks.createPr.noRemote: This repository has no origin remote on GitHub, so there is nowhere to open a PR.
tasks.createPr.neverSignsIn: AgentChainer never signs in for you or reads gh's credentials.
tasks.createPr.title: Create a pull request
tasks.createPr.explain: What the run left is committed on {{head}}, its changed files are scanned for secrets, and the branch is pushed (never forced). Nothing is merged.
tasks.createPr.body: Body (from the contract and the evidence)
tasks.deploy.title: Deploy
tasks.deploy.subtitle: Previews of this task's branch, with the provider's own CLI.
tasks.flow.ownFlowNote: It's approved with the contract, and the run follows it instead of the {{tier}} flow.
tasks.flow.suggestNote: The {{tier}} flow fits most tasks. Claude can shape one for this task from its contract, e.g. a test planner first, or a security review; it's checked like a hand-written workflow.
tasks.flow.suggest: Suggest a flow for this task
tasks.flow.noTier: The flow shows once the task has a tier: draft its contract first.
tasks.flow.subtasksNote: The sub-tasks, each on its own tier's workflow. Click one to open it.
tasks.flow.sourceTask: This task's own {{workflow}}. Click a step to see it in the thread.
tasks.flow.sourceTaskPlanned: This task's own {{workflow}}, as the run will follow it. Click a step to see it in the thread.
tasks.flow.sourceProject: The project's {{workflow}}. Click a step to see it in the thread.
tasks.flow.sourceProjectPlanned: The project's {{workflow}}, as the run will follow it. Click a step to see it in the thread.
tasks.flow.sourceApp: The app's {{workflow}}. Click a step to see it in the thread.
tasks.flow.sourceAppPlanned: The app's {{workflow}}, as the run will follow it. Click a step to see it in the thread.
tasks.home.title: Tasks in this workspace
tasks.home.subtitle: Start one with Task in a chat's composer
tasks.lessons.title: Lessons
tasks.lessons.subtitle: What this run suggests Claude should know next time, as CLAUDE.md lines.
tasks.lessons.added: Added to {{path}}. Roll it back in Workspace settings → History.
tasks.lessons.explain: Reads the run's records: gates that needed a fix, review findings, blocked or denied actions, the implementer's notes. One small model call (about $0.01).
tasks.lessons.applyNote: Added as a History run, so it can be rolled back. The ones not picked are dismissed.
tasks.mergeGates.merged: Merged by you ({{method}}) at {{sha}}, {{date}}. Pull it into your branch to get it locally.
tasks.mergeGates.mergedAccepted: Merged by you ({{method}}) at {{sha}}, {{date}}. Gates not green, accepted: {{reason}} Pull it into your branch to get it locally.
tasks.mergeGates.title: Merge gates
tasks.mergeGates.explain: Runs the scanners on the task's worktree and reads the PR's checks.
tasks.mergeGates.dialogDescription: On GitHub, at {{sha}}: a newer push makes this merge fail instead of slipping in.
tasks.mergeGates.draft: It's a draft: it is marked ready for review first.
tasks.mergeGates.whyHelp: Kept with the task and in its evidence report.
tasks.prChecks.title: Checks
tasks.prChecks.roundsUsed: This PR had its {{max}} Fix CI rounds.
tasks.prChecks.fixDescription: Round {{n}} of {{max}}. It counts against the task's budget.
tasks.prChecks.fixExplain: Claude gets this log as data, with the contract and the task's diff, and fixes the code in the task's worktree with the same approvals as the run. The gates run again, and only when they pass is the branch pushed (never forced).
tasks.schedule.description: Runs this approved task again on a schedule, while AgentChainer is open.
tasks.schedule.hourlyHelp: On the hour, counted from midnight.
tasks.schedule.edits: Edits are accepted; any other approval waits for you, and you get a notification.
tasks.schedule.onlyOpen: Runs only while AgentChainer is open. A time missed while it was closed runs once when it opens.
tasks.agents.title: Agents
tasks.agents.help: Which agent runs each kind of step. Only agents installed and signed in on this computer are offered; the app runs the checks either way.
